_note: Scripted model responses for MOCK_LLM=1. They are hand-written fixtures in the shape the prompts request, not recordings of real model output. Tests still run for real.

triage.summary: chunked() drops the final partial chunk, so inputs whose length is not a multiple of size lose items.
triage.searchQuery: python chunked list drops last partial chunk range len(items) - size + 1

repro.rationale: The issue shows the trailing item 5 is lost.
Covers the reported case, an input shorter than size, and the empty input.
repro.expectedFailure: AssertionError on the first two cases: the trailing partial chunk is missing

patch.explanation: The range stopped at len(items) - size + 1, which skips the start index of a final partial chunk. Iterating up to len(items) keeps it.
